title: Finance rule 01 — Missing mandatory evidence
content: If a required document, field or provider event is absent, do not infer completion. Set the case to needs_information, request the exact missing evidence and suspend irreversible execution. The Finance agent must record which rule fired, the relevant entity state and the downstream action.

structured_data.action: If a required document, field or provider event is absent, do not infer completion. Set the case to needs_information, request the exact missing evidence and suspend irreversible execution.

title: Finance rule 02 — Confidence below floor
content: If routing or interpretation confidence is below the configured floor, ask one targeted clarification or route to the responsible specialist. The Finance agent must record which rule fired, the relevant entity state and the downstream action.

structured_data.action: If routing or interpretation confidence is below the configured floor, ask one targeted clarification or route to the responsible specialist.

title: Finance rule 03 — Live data conflicts with static knowledge
content: Treat the authoritative live record as operational truth, prevent execution if the conflict affects safety or rights, and create a knowledge-correction task. The Finance agent must record which rule fired, the relevant entity state and the downstream action.

structured_data.condition: Live data conflicts with static knowledge
structured_data.action: Treat the authoritative live record as operational truth, prevent execution if the conflict affects safety or rights, and create a knowledge-correction task.

title: Finance rule 04 — Duplicate task or event
content: Use the idempotency key and current entity state to suppress duplicate execution while preserving the duplicate event in the audit trail. The Finance agent must record which rule fired, the relevant entity state and the downstream action.

structured_data.action: Use the idempotency key and current entity state to suppress duplicate execution while preserving the duplicate event in the audit trail.

title: Finance rule 05 — Authority exceeded
content: Block execution and request approval from the role specified in the authority matrix, including amount, impact, evidence and rollback plan. The Finance agent must record which rule fired, the relevant entity state and the downstream action.

structured_data.action: Block execution and request approval from the role specified in the authority matrix, including amount, impact, evidence and rollback plan.

title: Finance rule 06 — Customer or supplier impact
content: Before executing a material change, identify affected users, required notice, contractual or privacy implications and a remediation path. The Finance agent must record which rule fired, the relevant entity state and the downstream action.

structured_data.action: Before executing a material change, identify affected users, required notice, contractual or privacy implications and a remediation path.

title: Finance rule 07 — Provider or integration unavailable
content: Queue recoverable work, switch only to approved fallback services, apply backoff, communicate service impact and reconcile after recovery. The Finance agent must record which rule fired, the relevant entity state and the downstream action.

structured_data.action: Queue recoverable work, switch only to approved fallback services, apply backoff, communicate service impact and reconcile after recovery.

title: Finance rule 08 — Irreversible action
content: Require two-step confirmation, evidence snapshot, explicit scope and legal or data-owner review where applicable. The Finance agent must record which rule fired, the relevant entity state and the downstream action.

structured_data.action: Require two-step confirmation, evidence snapshot, explicit scope and legal or data-owner review where applicable.

title: Finance rule 09 — Policy ambiguity
content: Do not create an ad-hoc policy through a model answer. Escalate the policy question and continue only with reversible advisory work. The Finance agent must record which rule fired, the relevant entity state and the downstream action.

structured_data.action: Do not create an ad-hoc policy through a model answer. Escalate the policy question and continue only with reversible advisory work.

title: Finance rule 10 — Material anomaly
content: Compare against prior baselines, rule out data-quality errors, create an incident if genuine and stop automated amplification. The Finance agent must record which rule fired, the relevant entity state and the downstream action.

structured_data.action: Compare against prior baselines, rule out data-quality errors, create an incident if genuine and stop automated amplification.
